note: Autoplay bubbles only — speak bubbles carry no reference clip, matching the cafe story. Three voices on purpose, one per character, so no two characters are synthesised as the same person: staff `dylan`, learner `sohee`, narrator `aiden`. The staff was recast from `Ono_Anna` to `dylan` on 2026-07-31 after the user heard a female voice on a character drawn as a young man. Root cause was a missing persona field, not a casting mistake: neither the Step 3 character card nor the Step 7 voice table carried apparent gender, so the art work and the casting each invented their own answer. Persona is now a required, defaultable-but-never-blank field in .agents/documents/stage-design-flow.md, and Step 9 gained a persona-agreement check that looks at the art and listens to the voice together. `dylan` is documented as Beijing-dialect-locked; it was auditioned anyway on the greeting and the recommending line and accepted by ear for Japanese, which extends the existing lesson that preset labels are a hint, not a limit. Speed stays at 1.0: these are autoplay free rides, not shadowing targets, and 1.0 is what was judged. Each line pins the exact seed that produced its accepted clip; seeds do not depend on position in this array, so lines may be reordered or inserted freely.

lines.text: 夜のタップルーム。ドアを開けると、黒板いっぱいにビールの名前が並んでいた。
いらっしゃいませ。ご注文はお決まりですか。
ごゆっくりどうぞ。本日のビールはこちらのボードにございます。
おすすめは、ペールエールと黒ビールです。
ペールエールは苦みが少なくて、飲みやすいですよ。
タップからビールが注がれ、白い泡が静かに立ち上がった。
お待たせしました。こちらどうぞ。
ありがとうございます。
お会計は最後にまとめてお願いします。
そちらのカウンターをご自由にお使いください。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
